dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Green Bay Packers Prepare for Week 12 Matchup Against Los Angeles Rams
dailyTopNewsBrief.summary: At 6-4 and holding the NFC’s #7 seed, Head Coach Matt LaFleur’s Green Bay Packers prepare to face the 6-4 Los Angeles Rams on Thanksgiving Eve. Green Bay must navigate key interior offensive line injuries while relying on their league-leading explosive passing attack.
bullets: Starting running back Josh Jacobs, guard Sean Rhyan, guard Kevin Zeitler, and linebacker Zaire Franklin have been ruled out for Wednesday's game against Los Angeles, according to the official [Packers-Rams Injury Report](https://www.packers.com/news/packers-rams-injury-report-nov-22-2026).

Green Bay signed running back Pierre Strong Jr. to the practice squad and released edge rusher D.J. Johnson to manage backfield depth, per [Green Bay Packers Official](https://www.packers.com/team/transactions/#tx-a24dc24b80ae).

Pass rusher Micah Parsons remains a game-time decision on the PUP list, with Head Coach Matt LaFleur highlighting his elite athletic caliber ahead of the matchup via [packers.com Video](https://www.packers.com/video/matt-lafleur-on-micah-parsons-he-is-an-elite-player-he-is-an-elite-athlete-nov-22-2026).

Wide receiver Christian Watson noted 'we know what's at stake' on [packers.com Video](https://www.packers.com/video/christian-watson-we-know-what-s-at-stake-in-matchup-vs-the-rams-nov-22-2026), as Green Bay's #1-ranked explosive pass offense attempts to overcome their #32-ranked rushing attack (67.0 yards per game).
